text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
............"Landing Successful". All that 
remains is to transmit the "Signal".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...But before that. Will "Execute" a 
critical "Task".

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Meravigliosi...! Did you draw the picture 
on the cookie, Universe-san?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. A guitar, a bass, and musical 
notes. My "feelings" for Sounds of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I remember now... A beautiful canzone 
d'amore filled with chaos and passion!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the wonderful present. —Your 
feelings will surely reach them, 
Universe-san!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: WOOW! Is this for US?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, look at this! There are portraits of 
us drawn on the cookies, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe's "signal." Has it 
"transmitted" properly?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Does it mean "Thank you for helping"? 
Fufu... you're very welcome.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You have someone else to give one to as 
well, right? I'm sure your feelings will 
reach them.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Drawings of swords and books... Ah! These 
are ancient runes, amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "signal" to Rob Roy. Did you "receive" 
it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes, ...! I will savor every bite.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, you've been trying 
to convey your feelings to "someone" for a 
while now. Were you able to give it to 
them?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Negative. ..."REQU" a "check."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wah, tiramisu! Incredible, it looks just 
like something from a bakery...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Neo Universe's "signal," can it 
"convey" with this?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It definitely conveys! How Uni-san poured 
her heart into it, carefully making it... 
it comes through so vividly!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Please have confidence, Uni-san! I'm sure, 
absolutely sure it will go well!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Can you see me?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Are you "recognizing" Neo Universe?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Affirmative. If so—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Transmitting "signal." "PFY."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
How have you been doing? Neo Universe is 
doing well.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...There are so many things I want to tell 
you.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: That's why once more—I want to "run."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I want to "run" together with you.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...I will be "waiting."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One morning. On my way to the trainer's 
office, I crossed paths with Neo Universe.
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, did you manage to 
hand over the treats?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Affirmative. The "launch" was a "success."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "signal" was also 100% "CNVY". 
—"Right"?
